telescope.summary: A Dutch lens-grinder's device that, pointed upward the following year, ended the idea of a perfect and unchanging heaven.

locke.summary: Held that the mind begins without innate ideas and that government is legitimate only by consent of the governed.

spinoza.summary: Identified God with nature itself and argued for freedom of thought, for which he was expelled from his community and read in secret.

taj-mahal.summary: Mausoleum built by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal at Agra, the high point of Mughal architecture.

newton.summary: Showed that the same law of gravitation governs a falling apple and an orbiting moon, and built the calculus needed to prove it.
newton.note: Born 25 December 1642 by the Julian calendar England still used; 4 January 1643 in the Gregorian calendar used here.
